source: Uncle's Excel 'stock analysis using screener 1st aug', tab 'Nifty 50 analysis', columns X to BW (Screener data of 28 Oct 2026)
how: Each value is GREEN if it meets 'green', RED if it meets 'red', otherwise BLACK. Blank value = not counted. 'green' / 'red' are conditions like '>=2000', '<0', '20..50' (inclusive band) or empty (never). Red is checked first.

decision.text: Red less than 10, green above 20, black above 15
